description:
New dwellings approved each month in every council area from July 2021: houses, other residential (units, townhouses, apartments) and the total, with the value of the building work approved.

Coverage: 561 council areas in every state and territory; monthly, July 2021 to August 2026. Current to 2026-08-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/building-approvals`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: dwellings_houses, dwellings_other_residential, dwellings_total, value_houses_k, value_other_residential_k, value_total_k. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_planning_building_approvals
title: LGA · Building approvals by council
